name: Sanzo Wada - 348 Color Combinations

provenance.attribution: Palette data and website metadata: colorcombinations.org. Original combinations: Sanzo Wada, A Dictionary of Color Combinations (1933).
provenance.selection: The 348 numbered Wada plates only; the 30 additional editorial palettes are excluded.
transformations: Converted the public CSV export into a dictionary keyed by stable plate IDs.
Normalized HEX letter case to uppercase without changing color values.
Calculated RGB integer triplets directly from HEX.
Preserved website color names, color order, titles, mood tags, hue classifications, and era labels.

reference_notes: Look up a combination by its dictionary key (for example wada-001), plate_number, name, color name, HEX value, dominant_hue, or moods.
Cite the entry ID and plate number when returning a combination, and preserve its exact colors and order.
HEX and RGB describe the website digital color values, not measurements of original printed plates.
Names, mood tags, dominant hue, and era are website-supplied metadata; original spellings are preserved.
No fill, line, accent, material, or area-percentage roles are assigned by this dictionary. Any such assignment or derived palette is an interpretation.
Shared colors across different numbered combinations are intentional; retain all 348 combinations.
